messages:
maria: Anyone able to bump GPU quota in GCP (us-west1) for the new training fleet? I submitted a request but it's blocked by account verification. Ticket: 12345678. Need ~32 A100s for staging next week.
sam: Which project/cluster? Is this for redwood-dedicated-prod? If it's billing/verification we'll need finance/ops to coordinate. @lina can you check payment status?
lina: Saw the alert — Payments shows the last invoice failed to charge. Support flagged the account for business verification. They want business registration + tax form (W-9 or VAT) before approving quota increases.
gcp-support: Support case 987654321: "Your account requires business verification before quota increases. Please upload company registration docs and the appropriate tax form. Current payment method returned 'card declined' on 2026-03-12. Quota requests are pending verification."
maria: Ugh. Is there any temporary workaround? Can we route jobs to another region where we already have quota (us-central1) while finance sorts verification?
sam: Technically yes — us-central1 has spare quota (~12 A100s) but not full 32. We could do a phased rollout: provision 8-12 GPUs there for a canary and keep the rest queued. Will increase cross-region egress and slightly higher latency.
  Quick example command if we go that route:
  ```
  gcloud compute resource-quotas update --project=redwood-prod --region=us-central1 --add-accelerator=gpu:A100:8
  ```
lina: I'm uploading the W-9 and business registration PDFs now. @raj can you confirm legal name on the docs? Also opening a payment ticket to update card on file — support case 987654321 (same as above).
raj: Confirmed legal name matches: "Redwood Inference, Inc." I'll sign/verify the W-9. Lina, DM me the signing link.
gcp-support: Update: After document upload, verification ETA is 48-72 hours. Quota increases remain pending until verification completes. No provisional increases will be granted during review. We'll update the case when review finishes.
maria: OK thanks. Sam — please go ahead with the us-central1 canary plan and document any perf delta. Lina/raj please ping here once verification and payment are cleared so I can re-open the full quota request.
sam: Will do. I'll spin up an 8-GPU canary later today and post perf numbers. Leaving an internal follow-up: internal ticket INFRA-4123 to track cross-region fallback.
lina: Uploaded docs and new payment method added to portal. I also emailed accounting@support-gcp with proof of payment. Will post case updates here.
maria: Appreciate it. :thumbsup:
